title: Classic Indian Lamb Rogan Josh
description: A popular and flavorful North Indian curry made with tender lamb pieces, aromatic spices, and a rich sauce.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until browned, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the Rogan josh spice mix, cayenne pepper, and salt. Mix well.
Add the velvety tomato puree and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over basmati rice or with naan bread.
